scope: Additive Rage Vial L1-18 active effect and modifier-order audit; retain pinned per-level data without inventing a combat tick contract.
game_version: Official 2023-12-12 Hero Equipment introduction; game-file table dated 2026-09-01 and claimed client build 18.600.3 on 2026-09-16; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Each Hero may equip two Equipment items; active effects require a manual battle activation. Rage Vial is Common active Barbarian King Equipment that rages the King, increases his damage and movement speed, and recovers HP.
sources.limitations: No numerical duration, per-level scalar, modifier stage, healing order, activation window or overlap rule is published here.

sources.title: Rage Vial: costs, times and levels — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The TH18 maximum is L18. Per-level DPS increase, Hero HP recovery, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements agree with the pinned payload; DPS runs 17-128 and recovery 150-1890.
sources.limitations: The page does not provide Rage damage or speed scalars, activation timing, healing phase, or modifier stacking.

sources.title: Rage Vial — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The game-file-derived page confirms L1-18 DPS increases of 17-128 and the same ore costs as GiBiArena.
sources.limitations: The table omits Hero HP recovery, Rage duration, damage and speed multipliers, and interaction order.

sources.title: Pinned Rage Vial Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The normalized source_fields preserve top-level abilityDuration 10 and per-level hpRecoveryIncrease, damageIncrease, movementSpeedIncrease and dpsIncrease.
sources.limitations: Exact current-build continuity of duration and Rage scalars is unconfirmed; the payload does not define modifier stage, stacking, rounding or first and last effective tick.

derivations.result: Retain pinned duration, per-level Rage, DPS, speed and recovery fields data-only
derivations.method: SHA-check the frozen raw source_fields and compare all per-level DPS and recovery values with the dated GiBiArena table; independently corroborate DPS and ore costs with Goblins Farm. No modifier timing or rounding is inferred.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply damageIncrease and dpsIncrease multiplicatively to the same base DPS
rejected_inferences.reason: The two fields have different roles, but no checked source specifies their application order or whether one is passive and one active.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply hpRecoveryIncrease before incoming damage at the command tick
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source establishes whether recovery occurs before or after combat damage, death, or other Equipment activations.

rejected_inferences.rule: Round ten seconds to exactly 1000 fixed ticks starting with the activation tick
rejected_inferences.reason: Ten seconds maps to 1000 logical ticks, but first and last effective tick and command-phase ordering are not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use Rage Spell stacking and rounding rules
rejected_inferences.reason: Rage Vial affects the King, but the sources do not say its damage and speed modifiers share Rage Spell stacking semantics.

items: current-build continuity of 10-second duration and per-level Rage scalars
passive DPS bonus versus active damage multiplier stage and rounding
movement-speed scalar units and path-step rounding
activation command, first and final buff tick and death ordering
HP recovery timing and max-HP cap
simultaneous two-Equipment activation and Pet interaction
Rage Spell, Grand Warden aura and other damage/speed modifier stacking
Viewer controls, overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation contract

conclusion: Rage Vial L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Its active King Rage, damage, speed and HP recovery are official, and dated tables corroborate pinned DPS and recovery data; effect order and stacking remain insufficient for a faithful Core implementation.
